event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: Panel composed as per RRS N1.4(b)
facts: SI 14 states: "(...) length of course, directions of leg and the wind direction and speed will not be grounds for request for redress by a boat. This changes RRS 61.1(a)."
The request for redress concerns the wind direction and the direction of the leg.
conclusions: The alleged improper action can not be grounds for a request for redress by a boat as per RRS 61.1(a) as amended by SI 14.
